title: Art Tatum's beer drinking and the piano
summary: All Tatum wanted was a good piano; Royal describes his case-a-night beer capacity.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: Always someplace to play. All Art wanted was a good piano and there was someplace to play right there when he got to the piano. He was staying -- sometime we used to -- at that time, he was drinking Pabst Blue Ribbon beer and we used to stack the beer until it reached the ceiling and then start another stack until it could reach the ceiling.

We'd just drink beer all night long and anybody that knew that Art was coming over to play the piano who was running the after-hour joint, they always had two, three, four cases of beer that would be consumed.
He could drink that much at one time?
Oh, he could drink a case anytime at a sitting. He had quite a capacity for beer. Of course, he had to get up and go to the toilet quite often, but still had a nice capacity.
